purpose: Isolate and execute the custom PartType6 transport contract in the real pinned SWIFT executable while deliberately removing the upstream massive-neutrino background GSL integral that blocked the parent before any particle dynamics.
interpretation_boundary: Artificial transport-only cosmology. PASS proves executable custom nonthermal neutrino-particle transport and no Fermi-Dirac resampling; it does not validate the physical N_nu=1 cosmology, self-gravity, halo response, or detectability.

artificial_transport_background.note: N_nu=0 is an engine-isolation device only. PartType6 particles remain neutrino particle type and therefore retain SWIFT's relativistic neutrino drift correction.

custom_particle_kinematics.velocity_definition: v_IC = q*c*T_nu0/(a_begin*m_nu) times the matched direction, exactly as in the parent K01D1 design.
custom_particle_kinematics.macro_particle_mass_role: Common positive inert engineering mass only; no self-gravity and no cosmological particle-mass closure check are active.

engine_modes.external_gravity: ConstantPotential with g_cgs=[0,0,0] only to satisfy the SWIFT engine policy.

preregistered_acceptance.no_FD_resampling: If snapshot Weights exists it must be identically 1; if SampledSpeeds exists it must be identically 0.

stopping_and_next.if_fail: Do not proceed to self-gravity. Diagnose only the executable transport contract.
stopping_and_next.note: Even if R1 passes, K01E self-gravity is not authorized until a separately preregistered and independently validated physical N_nu=1 background path passes.
